usedBy: Use this building block in the side column of a desktop payment screen. It keeps transaction rows and their total together in a card.
overview: A desktop side-column summary that groups transaction rows and their total in a card, with an optional notice and action.

default.title: With title
default.text: The optional heading sits above the light-up card; rows and total stay inside the card.

without-title.title: Without title
without-title.text: Omit the heading when the surrounding page already labels the summary.

with-notice.title: With notice
with-notice.text: The notice follows the card and overlaps it by 16px. The action stays outside both.

api.intro: Transaction Summary is available on Web only and uses the same read-only row and total structure as the Footer.
api.title: Optional heading displayed above the card.
api.items: Read-only transaction rows. The first row uses default density and following rows use compact density.
api.total: Label and value rendered after a divider below the transaction rows.
api.notice: Optional structured notice with a required title, optional description and optional custom icon. When omitted, an Ocean positive check icon is used.
api.action: Optional consumer-provided action rendered full width below the card and notice.
api.className: Additional class name for the root element.

platforms.ios: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.
platforms.android: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.

rules: Use Summary in the desktop side column of a payment screen.
Pass no more than five items. The component drops additional rows and renders the total separately.
Keep the action outside the card; when present, it follows the card and optional notice.
Use TransactionListReadOnly props for row content, including extra information, tags and struck-through values.
Sticky positioning and safe-area behavior belong to the screen, not the Summary component.
